description: Discovery finds where plugin code lives (entry points, a package scan, a list); registration runs when a plugin class is created and records or validates it.
Packaging metadata (`[project.entry-points."group"]`) read with `importlib.metadata.entry_points(group=...)` without importing; `EntryPoint.load()` imports one plugin.
A base-class hook that runs for every subclass at any depth, under any metaclass, so validation needs no manual step from plugin authors.
`TypeError` raised when a class's bases have metaclasses where neither derives from the other, such as a registry metaclass and `pydantic.BaseModel`.
Plugin modules × measured import cost, compared with the startup time the core leaves; over budget means lazy loading.
Loading an entry point runs code from the distribution that declared it, so hosts allow-list the distributions that may provide plugins.
